alpha: straight, 0 at both t ends — these are decals, not tiles
axes: s runs ALONG the shore and tiles; t runs ACROSS the boundary. t = 0 landward/upper, t = 1 seaward/lower.
sample: s = frac(arc / 8); t = (d - line) / 4 + anchor; if (t < 0 || t > 1) skip; rgb = lerp(bandRGB, strip.rgb, strip.a)

edges.name: Turf lip
steps: a clean sod lip, tension cracks behind
failing — gashes, turf hanging, clods on the face

edges.name: Scarp
steps: working, with a fan at the toe
deep gullies, slump blocks, sticks at the foot

edges.name: Wrack line
steps: a storm line — three berms, driftwood

edges.name: Weed line
steps: high, thin and hard — an exposed headland
broad and ragged — a sheltered cove

edges.name: Reef margin
edges.note: t = 0 is ON the bed and is left almost entirely transparent — the painted bed shows through. t = 1 is the open flat.
steps: a soft margin, the bed just thinning out
a rim, a moat, an apron of loose shell
an eroding margin — undercut rim, deep moat, outliers well out

strips.note: Terrain pass 9 (PR 2 of docs/design/st-peters-terrain-pass-9.md): a second kind of strip. It is drawn in the ground's own materials along a centre line, not as a decal PNG across a boundary, so none of the decal fields above apply to it. The splat cannot hold a rut at 0.5 m per texel, so a strip carries it. PR 2 defines the kind; PR 5 lays the ruts along St Peters' cart tracks.
strips.sample: d = distance from the track's centre line (m); a texel is rut where |d - offsetMetres| < halfWidthMetres + wobbleMetres * snoise(x, y, wobbleWavelengthMetres); a rut texel draws material, or puddle where fbm(along / puddleScaleMetres.along, across / puddleScaleMetres.across) > puddleAbove

items.name: Cart ruts
items.from: The pass 9 kit's meadow road (pxKit9.js): a rut 5.5 px either side of the centre, 1.6 px half-width, in dirt, and mud where fb(x / 12, y / 5) > 0.64 with x along the road; at 32 px/m the puddle scales are 0.375 m along and 0.156 m across. The offset, half-width and wobble are St Peters' cart-track scale, from part 1's preview (|d - 0.45| < 0.07 + 0.02 snoise at 0.8 m, docs/design/st-peters-terrain-pass-9.md §5).
